title: Besov regularity of solutions to the Dirichlet problem for the Bessel $(p,s)$-Laplacian
summary: We study the Dirichlet problem for a class of fractional $p$-Laplacian operators of order $s \in (0,1)$ defined through the Riesz fractional gradient, which differs fundamentally from the standard fractional $p$-Laplacian. Our analysis combines the framework of Lions-Calderón spaces, Besov embeddings, and an adaptation of Nirenberg's difference quotient method, originally developed by Savaré, to the fractional Riesz setting.
